data.title: Binance Completes Harmony Lottery Draw and Will Open Trading For ONE
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance has completed the Harmony lottery draw, with a 30.82% ratio of winning tickets. The results of the lottery draw are summarized below.

No. of Digits

Tail Digits Drawn in the Lottery

No. of Winning Tickets

1 Tail Digit

2 Tail Digits

None

-

432

4 Tail Digits

3893

6

5 Tail Digits

11757, 31790, 33840, 05929, 02119

5
 

Total

16,666

 

Binance will also open trading for ONE/BNB, ONE/BTC, ONE/USDT, ONE/TUSD, ONE/PAX and ONE/USDC trading pairs at 2019/06/01 04:00 AM (UTC).

Harmony Listing Fee: 0 BNB.

Note:

  • Please ensure that you have sufficient BNB in your account based on the number of your winning tickets. We have started deducting BNB from winning accounts at 2019/05/28 08:00 AM (UTC), and users will have 24 hours until 2019/05/29 08:00 AM (UTC) to credit their accounts with BNB, at which point the distribution of ONE will be complete.
  • The token purchase price was set at 1 ONE = 0.000092 BNB / 0.003175 USD (using a BNB price of 34.5726 USD) as per the previous announcement here.
  • The Harmony (ONE) token asset page is available on the Binance Chain explorer here https://explorer.binance.org/asset/ONE-5F9 .

For a full recap of the Harmony token sale, read our blog post here.

To learn more about the Harmony project, read the in-depth report by Binance Research here.

Details:

  3. Rules

Risk warning: Cryptocurrency investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments cautiously. Binance will make best efforts to choose high quality coins, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/05/28
